Input image: STYLE-ONLY reference for broad shaded facets, chunky stepped pixel clusters, thick near-black outlines and strong foreground/background hierarchy; never copy its fist, burgundy palette or repeated radiating scratch pattern. One or two large simple readable foreground shapes occupy most of square, broad quiet color planes and crisp facet highlights, no miniature details. Frost Mage tree uniform background base opaque dark MUTED BLUE SLATE #1c2b33, slightly lighter #31434f planes. Foreground effect colors represent mechanics: silver-white ice and cyan-blue cold, muted violet magical protection, red wound/low-health indicators, green healing indicators, natural silver accents on solid objects. Effects stay behind main shape, shapes remain separate and readable. No fixed repeated scratch motif, no ornamental ray pattern repeated across set, no frame,text,UI,watermark,photorealism,smooth gradients,noise,tiny sparkles or microtexture. Chill becoming hard freeze.
